title: Most Champions League wins
brief: Name the ten clubs that have won the most Champions League matches since 1992/93. Wins after extra time count; shoot-outs count as draws.
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2025/26, group or league stage onwards; in 1992/93 and 1993/94 the first and second rounds count, as UEFA counts them

notes.AC Milan: AC Milan are just outside with 94.

checks: UEFA.com team stats summed over every season, and a recount from every main-tournament result in UEFA's match data, give identical figures. Transfermarkt's all-time table for 1992/93 to 2025/26 has the same top ten in the same order but slightly higher totals for some clubs (Real Madrid 212, Bayern 193, Barcelona 188) because it lists a few more matches than UEFA (AC Milan 211 against UEFA's 207, which matches the rounds Milan actually played); on Transfermarkt's figures AC Milan tie Liverpool on 95.
